address: Liebigstraße 15, Frankfurt on the Main, 60323, Germany
bio: Savoir-vivre in Frankfurt! Valéry Mathis's modern and seasonally influenced French cuisine has been held in high esteem for many years. Flavoursome and expertly prepared dishes are served in a charming bistro atmosphere, which is enhanced by the authentic interior with wood panelling and decorative details. Friendly and down-to-earth yet highly competent service courtesy of the team led by owner Eric Huber. You can also look forward to savvy wine recommendations – the emphasis here is on French labels. There is also a delightful terrace. It is no accident that this place is so popular!...
